bootstrap, vendored (basicly-lywzp71).

package   bootstrap
version   5.3.8
licence   MIT, verbatim in LICENSE beside this file
upstream  https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap
tarball   https://registry.npmjs.org/bootstrap/-/bootstrap-5.3.8.tgz
integrity sha512-HP1SZDqaLDPwsNiqRqi5NcP0SSXciX2s9E+RyqJIIqGo+vJeN5AJVM98CXmW/Wux0nQ5L7jeWUdplCEf0Ee+tg==

The same version is pinned as an exact dev dependency in `package.json`, and the integrity
above is the `integrity` field `package-lock.json` records for it. `bootstrap.min.css` is
`dist/css/bootstrap.min.css` from that release, byte for byte; its first comment names the
version, and `tests/test_board_assets.py` asserts that version against the pin so a refresh
that moves one and not the other fails.

Only the compiled stylesheet is committed. No script: the board carries no JavaScript, so
bootstrap's bundle, and popper it peers on, are not vendored. No source Sass either: the
board keeps its own palette by overriding bootstrap's CSS custom properties in the page,
which needs no build step.

The page references the stylesheet by a relative path, never an origin: the server answers
`/vendor/bootstrap.min.css` and `board --out` writes `vendor/` beside the pages, so a page
opened from disk or from the server renders with no network.

To refresh: bump the pin in `package.json`, `npm install`, copy
`node_modules/bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css` and `node_modules/bootstrap/LICENSE`
here, update the version and integrity above, and re-run
`uv run pytest tests/test_board_assets.py`.
